newsitem.title: LEBANON: Shares mixed on Beirut bourse.
newsitem.headline: Shares mixed on Beirut bourse.

text.p: Shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday amid heavy demand for Bank of Beirut and Solidere A and B shares.
Solidere B shares rose to $13 from $12.875 while A shares held steady $12.875.
A total of 305,862 A shares and 170,296 B shares were demanded in the second fixing out of which 61,408 shares and 43,096 shares were traded respectively.
Brokers expected Solidere shares to get stronger.
"Solidere will continue climbing as it is a value stock," said one broker.
A total of 111,732 BOB shares were demanded, out of which 10,450 shares changed hands at $5.5625 up from Monday's $5.50.
Banque Audi was steady at $27.25 and a total of 30,000 shares were traded in a block outside the floor at the same price.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce fell to $20.25 from $20.5.
The LIBX bank index fell 0.03 percent to 189.21, the LISPI general index fell 0.20 percent to 96.14 while the BLOM general index rose 0.21 percent to 1103.95.
BSE turnover rose 112.6 percent to 198,484 shares from 93,318 shares a day earlier for a value of $2,977,640 against $1,253,155.
Of the four listed indistrial firms, shares of Eternit were unchanged at $1.9062 from when they were last traded on August 8.
Shares of Ciments Blancs changed hands at $4 down from $4.125 when they were last traded on June 20.
There was no trade in the other listed industrial firms -- Ciments Libanais and Uniceramic.
